answer: Mingalar Edu helps Myanmar students explore study options in China, Europe and Korea, prepare university applications and organise visa documents. Choose a destination or use Find my program to start your conversation with our team.

steps.name: Explore your options
steps.description: Discuss your goals and shortlist a country, school and programme.

steps.name: Prepare your application
steps.description: Confirm requirements, organise documents and follow up with admissions.

steps.name: Plan your departure
steps.description: Prepare visa documents and discuss pre-departure arrangements.

faq.question: How much does it cost to use Mingalar Edu's services?
faq.answer: Service fees vary depending on the destination and product you choose. Fees: contact us. Ask for a written breakdown of the service scope, included support and excluded costs before payment.

faq.question: What if my visa gets rejected?
faq.answer: Contact us to review the decision and discuss possible next steps. Any further application support and its cost must be agreed before proceeding.

faq.question: Do I need to speak the local language before applying?
faq.answer: Language requirements depend on the school and programme. Contact us to confirm the teaching language and discuss language preparation for your chosen destination.

faq.question: Can I work while studying abroad?
faq.answer: Work permissions depend on your destination, visa and course. Ask our team about the current requirements for your chosen destination before making work plans.

faq.question: How can Mingalar Edu support my study plans?
faq.answer: We help you explore destinations based on your goals and budget, prepare university applications, and plan for life abroad. Contact us to discuss the support available for your chosen destination.
